# FocusArx

> FocusArx is a free, browser-based focus and deep work platform. It combines a
> Pomodoro and deep work timer, task and habit tracking, session analytics, live
> study rooms, and an AI coach. The core is free forever; Premium is unlocked with
> Focus Tokens earned by completing sessions rather than purchased.

FocusArx targets students and professionals who need external structure to start
and sustain focused work. Optional attention monitoring runs entirely on-device
with MediaPipe — video is never uploaded.

## Claim policy

Every metric FocusArx publishes appears on the claim ledger with a definition,
source, sample and date. We publish no ratings, user counts or improvement
percentages we cannot source, and we make no medical, diagnostic or treatment
claims. See https://www.focusarx.site/evidence

## Free tools

- [Pomodoro Timer](https://www.focusarx.site/pomodoro-timer): free 25/5 browser timer with custom intervals from 10–180 minutes, session history and streaks. No signup required to start.
- [Focus Timer](https://www.focusarx.site/focus-timer): focus and deep work sessions with Focus Tokens, city progression and analytics.
- [Study Timer](https://www.focusarx.site/study-timer): timed study blocks tied to subjects, for exam revision planning.
- [Study Time Calculator](https://www.focusarx.site/study-calculator): enter an exam date and topic list, get a dated revision schedule with spaced repeats.
- [Study Method Quiz](https://www.focusarx.site/study-method-quiz): two minutes to match a study method to your schedule and goals.
- [60-Second Scroll Reset](https://www.focusarx.site/break-free): a short interruption pattern for breaking a distraction loop.
- [Breathing Reset](https://www.focusarx.site/breathe): a two-minute guided reset between study blocks.

## Guides

- [How to Focus: Complete Guide](https://www.focusarx.site/focus-guide): why focus is hard, the neuroscience of attention, and a system to rebuild concentration.
- [Deep Work Guide](https://www.focusarx.site/deep-work-guide): what deep work is, the four scheduling patterns, and how to protect a block once it starts.
- [The Pomodoro Technique](https://www.focusarx.site/pomodoro-guide): how to run 25/5 sprints correctly, and when to use longer intervals instead.
- [Best Study Techniques](https://www.focusarx.site/study-techniques): active recall, spaced repetition and interleaving, ranked by evidence.
- [How to Focus While Studying](https://www.focusarx.site/how-to-focus-while-studying): nine changes ordered by impact and effort.
- [Body Doubling](https://www.focusarx.site/body-doubling): why working alongside someone else makes starting easier, and how to use it online.
- [How to Focus with ADHD](https://www.focusarx.site/adhd-focus-tips): strategies designed around external structure. Workflow design, not medical advice.
- [ADHD-Friendly Focus Tools](https://www.focusarx.site/adhd-focus-tools): visual timers, body doubling rooms, task breakdown and recovery-friendly streaks.
- [How to Stop Procrastinating](https://www.focusarx.site/stop-procrastinating): why procrastination happens and twelve methods to interrupt it.
- [How to Stop Scrolling](https://www.focusarx.site/stop-scrolling): why the loop persists and a 60-second reset that works.
- [Best Music for Studying](https://www.focusarx.site/focus-music): what the evidence says about lo-fi, binaural beats and silence.
- [The Science of Deep Work](https://www.focusarx.site/science-of-deep-work): what happens in the brain during sustained concentration.
- [The 2-Hour Study Method](https://www.focusarx.site/two-hour-study-method): a structured block — warm-up, deep study, retrieval, review.
- [The Feynman Technique](https://www.focusarx.site/feynman-technique): learn deeply by explaining in plain language and attacking the gaps.
- [Guide Library](https://www.focusarx.site/guides): every guide in one place.

## Exam preparation (India-first)

- [Exam Prep Hub](https://www.focusarx.site/exam): 14 guides covering JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET-UG, CBSE Class 12, CBSE Class 10, GATE, CAT, UPSC CSE, SSC CGL, NDA, CTET, IBPS PO, exam anxiety and last-minute revision.

## Study rooms

- [Virtual Study Rooms](https://www.focusarx.site/virtual-study-room): study alongside other learners with a synchronised timer. Camera optional and off by default.
- [Study With Me](https://www.focusarx.site/study-with-me): how live study-with-me sessions work and why they make starting easier.
- [Live Study Rooms](https://www.focusarx.site/study-rooms): currently running rooms.
- [Room Safety and Moderation](https://www.focusarx.site/safety): defaults, reporting, moderation and escalation.
